summary: Frontend-only verification of the three site-plan P2 features on RoofSpan Office. All acceptance criteria met. Estimate EST-1041 header shows 'Site Plan PDF' (data-testid=estimate-site-plan-pdf) that downloads site-plan.pdf. Proposal /quotes/3524e39f-.../proposal shows 'Site Plan PDF' (data-testid=proposal-site-plan-pdf) next to proposal-download-pdf; click downloads site-plan.pdf. Worksheet (lead e7b41ad7-cc50-4a56-ae70-30558c974c4a, revision 7d466513): after seeding a 2nd structure with facets via PUT /api/measurements/{rev} and doing one worksheet Save, the Combined Site Plan renders with data-testid=combined-site-plan, green data-testid=site-plan-saved-badge shows 'Site plan saved just now · download' and downloads a PDF on click. Editing a facet length triggered the amber data-testid=site-plan-stale-nudge BUTTON reading 'Measurements changed — re-save'; clicking it re-saved in place, the nudge disappeared, and the badge refreshed to 'saved just now'. After a 2nd re-save, data-testid=site-plan-history-toggle appeared as 'History (3)'; clicking it opened data-testid=site-plan-history-panel listing rows site-plan-history-row-3 (latest), -row-2, -row-1, each with a working site-plan-history-download-{version} button (v1 downloaded as site-plan-v1.pdf). Regression: site-plan-export-png / site-plan-export-pdf buttons still present; worksheet Save works. No blocking issues.

integration_issues.issue: 'Site plan re-saved' toast selector count was 0 immediately after click — toast likely auto-dismissed by the time the assertion ran (5s wait). UI state (nudge gone, badge = 'saved just now', history increments) confirms the re-save succeeded, so this is a minor timing artifact of the sonner toast, not a functional bug.

issues: When only 1 of 2 structures has resolvable geometry, the summary reads '1 structure combined — 1 needs review'. Copy is technically correct but the SVG then renders only one placed structure while the sibling 'Auto-Inferred — add roof lines to refine' badge appears on the other structure. Consider making it clearer that the un-placed structure won't appear in the exported PDF until roof lines are added.

critical_code_review_comments: CombinedSitePlan.jsx line 193: useEffect dep `sitePlan && sitePlan.assets_updated_at` is a plain expression, not an array — the second useEffect argument is not an array, which is a react-hooks bug. It works accidentally because the truthy value equals the timestamp string, but on transitions from truthy→null it fires unnecessarily. Should be `[sitePlan?.assets_updated_at]`.

CombinedSitePlan.jsx: planStale requires savedFingerprint to be non-null, so a pre-existing saved plan (from before the fingerprint field was added) never shows the stale nudge until one fresh worksheet-Save persists a fingerprint. Consider back-filling by computing the fingerprint of the current facets/edges at load time when sitePlan exists but fingerprint is missing, or triggering an implicit silent re-save.
seed_data_creation: PUT /api/measurements/7d466513-14c9-442c-b9a8-eade57e53987 with 2 structures (Main House, Detached Garage) and 4 facets to enable the Combined Site Plan on lead e7b41ad7-cc50-4a56-ae70-30558c974c4a. Then via UI: 1x worksheet Save + 2x nudge re-saves produced history versions v1, v2, v3.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lead e7b41ad7-cc50-4a56-ae70-30558c974c4a / revision 7d466513-... now has 2 structures + 4 facets and 3 site-plan history versions saved from this run — no further seeding needed to re-verify. To force a fresh stale-nudge cycle, use PUT /api/measurements/{rev} to bump any facet's length_ft or open the worksheet and edit an input, then click data-testid=site-plan-stale-nudge. Login redirects to '/' (NOT '/dashboard') — do not wait_for_url('**/dashboard**').
